title: Users
subtitle: You can see and manage accounts ranked below your own, and super admins can manage each other. Accounts are created here — there is no public sign-up.
newUserSubtitle: You can only create roles you are permitted to assign.
deleteBody: {email} will be permanently removed, along with their sessions and sign-in credentials. This cannot be undone.
banBody: {email} will be signed out and blocked from signing in. You can undo this at any time.
unbanBody: {email} will be able to sign in again.

form.name: Name
form.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Share it with the user directly — they can change it after signing in.

editHint: Ban and delete live in Edit, next to the role.

editor.title: Edit {name}
editor.bannedHint: Signed out and blocked from signing in.
editor.deleteHint: Removes the account with its sessions and credentials. This cannot be undone.
